description:
Music video directed by Keisuke Hiroe for the song Yuusha by YOASOBI. The song is based on a special novel written by Jirou Kiso, supervised by Kanehito Yamada.

Note: The song featured in this music video also serves as the first opening theme of the anime Sousou no Frieren. There exists two versions of this video; the first being a Japanese version uploaded on September 29, 2023 and an English version of the song titled "The Brave" by YOASOBI, which was uploaded on November 24, 2023.
